answer: Each of 192 aliases needs its own finish histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A fell running club membership with race finish history works as the gate: finishes logged with one club season after season. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The wharf record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the terrace entry is checkable by anyone, and the zenith window closes before a farm can catch up.
